jobs.prompt:
Edit an identity reference into a complete whole-figure pixel-art walking sheet. INPUT1 is the EXACT identity, anatomy, color, breadth, accessories, and front view moving DOWN toward camera master. INPUT2 guides only compact alternating foot contacts, never its body, pose width, face, colors or equipment. Stocky pale biped, tiny recessed face, ribbed pale belly, prominent asymmetric dark red exposed shoulder/back mass. Red mass on image RIGHT front, LEFT rear. Exactly two thick legs and two long heavy arms with attached dark claw tips. Keep the same broad hunch; rear exposes red dorsal tissue and back ribs, no face on back.
Use exactly 3 equal columns x 3 equal rows. First 8 distinct poses in row-major order: left contact, left load, low right pass, right set-down, right contact, right load, low left pass, left set-down. Ninth fully grounded idle. Keep one weight-bearing foot down, short low steps with stable width, very slight counter-swing and negligible head bob. No high knee, split, running, jumping or body sway independent of the head. Maintain the complete reference silhouette 59 x 62 native pixels, width/height within 5–8% of the reference. Keep the original shoulder volume, asymmetry and limb lengths. Hands and carried shapes stay attached in every phase. Maintain front anatomy and perspective throughout. Every whole figure must fit its own cell with clear transparent margin.
Matte native64 pixel clusters, original shaded materials and dark contours. Do not brighten highlights, add outlines of another color, fringe specks, blur, glow or 3D effects. True transparent alpha zero outside figures and through gaps. No background, floor, shadow, checkerboard, border, text or labels. No extra limbs, equipment, horns, armor or wings.
